title: 美银CEO莫伊尼汉：发行节奏延迟，市场信心待修复
speaker: Brian Moynihan

segments.en: And the team's done a good job of captioning their pieces. What gives you confidence the activity is delayed and not to route?
segments.zh: 团队在标注方面做得不错。是什么让你确信活动只是延迟，而非改道？

segments.en: Well, the companies we're talking about moving from this core next quarter.
segments.zh: 我们谈论的公司正从核心业务在下季度转移。

segments.en: They're on a path. It's just a matter of making sure all the ducks in a row enter space for them to get out there.
segments.zh: 他们已在路上。只需确保一切就绪，让他们能顺利推进。

segments.en: They're in different fields than Nvidia.
segments.zh: 他们所处的领域与英伟达不同。

segments.en: So these are IPOs that can get done.
segments.zh: 所以这些是可以完成的IPO。

segments.en: Sometimes it just takes time to get the investor's attention off of what's going on now onto a smaller cup.
segments.zh: 有时只需时间让市场参与者将注意力从当前事务转移到较小标的。

segments.en: These are multiple smaller than Anthropic.
It was sort of a Freudian slip in video, not Anthropic, but I think it does kind of raise.
segments.zh: 这算是视频中的弗洛伊德式口误，不是Anthropic，但我觉得确实引出了话题。

segments.en: We'll get to them. We'll get to the conversation. I mean, I do want to ask how much.
segments.zh: 我们会谈到他们。我们会继续对话。我的意思是，我确实想问多少。

segments.en: That's going to potentially create that roadblock to get the deals done in the near term of the sort of overhang of what that backstop looks like financially to so many different companies.
segments.zh: 这可能在短期内给交易达成设置障碍，因为对许多公司而言，这种财务支持措施会带来不确定性。
